release_notes: The app now opens into a new Autopilot-first home instead of exposing the legacy workspace as the main workflow.
Daily navigation is reduced to Autopilot, Create, Performance, Library, Advanced and Settings; the detailed managers remain available under Advanced.
The Autopilot home shows the next release, schedule coverage, only tasks that genuinely need human input, and the current Growth Analytics category signal.
Generate + Fill Schedule launches the existing Generate + Autopilot production flow directly from the home page.
The home page separates work Autopilot handles automatically from platform-limited/manual tasks such as Related Video, Instagram scheduling, packaging rescue approval and viewer-reply approval.
The top bar is simplified and the old Production shortcut is removed from normal daily use without deleting any underlying tools.
